human_summary: Multiple source records report that two university students, named as Redwan and Apu, were killed after a DNCC garbage truck hit their motorcycle in the Konapara area of Demra, Dhaka. The Business Standard family and a Dhaka Tribune repost both carry the same collision account [ev_2e2e59eb3bfdfb64, ev_5a4ec4c3f6f0abd5, ev_9e4a653608620eff]. A classmate quoted in both reports said the victims were returning from a wedding around 4:30am; that timing is preserved as a reported claim [ev_031d7714f37e547d, ev_738d53c92c9d089d]. Fused casualty data are two fatalities and no reported injury count. Location is Konapara in Demra at a gazetteer centroid with about 3 km uncertainty [ev_1d44c58721ec92c0, ev_244b71a7a2c0143a]. A broader Demra map area appears as an alternative [ev_1eacca6cdb82b6ae]. No official cause, fault, traffic effects, emergency response, or later development was supplied. The main unresolved uncertainty is the exact crash point; the only time precision is an 'around 4:30am' account. A reader comment blamed 'both sides' but is not treated as a finding [ev_bc4144b4e776d8ef].

sentiment.coverage_note: No coded sentiment records were supplied. One reader comment in evidence blames 'both sides' and says drivers 'drive crazy' in the area [ev_bc4144b4e776d8ef], but it was not included in the sentiment records and no polarity score is inferred.
notable_minority_views: A commenter said both sides could be at fault and described drivers in the Jatrabari/Demra/Konapara/Shonir Akhra zone as driving crazily [ev_bc4144b4e776d8ef].

title: Fatal truck-motorcycle collision in Konapara, Demra
unresolved_questions: What is the exact crash point within Konapara/Demra? Supplied coordinates are gazetteer centroids, not precise incident locations.
Is the 'around 4:30am' time an official time or only the classmate's account? The source text attributes it to the victims' classmate.
Were there any injuries beyond the two reported fatalities? No explicit injury count was reported.
What was the official cause or fault determination? No investigative or police statement is provided.
